_readme: Ground truth for the seeded corpus (repo_alpha, repo_beta). Every category value is one of: real_secret, placeholder, test_fixture, non_secret_high_entropy, not_a_candidate. 'not_a_candidate' means the line should never be flagged at all (e.g. loaded from an env var, no literal value present). Use eval/metrics.py against this file plus a detector's JSON output to compute precision/recall/F1. All values in this corpus are synthetic -- none are real, working credentials.
